verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents its own background automations: Snowpipe loads files as soon as they land in a stage, replacing manually run COPY statements on a schedule, and dbt Projects on Snowflake offers built-in orchestration of transformations. Resource monitors can also auto-suspend warehouses at credit limits. However, the pack shows no general-purpose scheduler or AI/agent-driven background automation. Missing for 10: documented scheduled task/job orchestration (e.g., cron-style tasks), autonomous AI agent workflows running in the background, detail on dynamic-table auto-refresh, and independent corroboration.
